title: Client details, date of birth and profile-only clients
summary: Client records now store first name, last name and date of birth, with profile-only accounts that cannot sign in until invited.
changes: user_profiles gains first_name, last_name and date_of_birth, with a careful name backfill and a staff list for ambiguous splits.
users.account_state distinguishes profile-only, invited and active clients; profile-only cannot use password, passkey or reset links.
Staff client create, public register and onboarding require first name, last name, date of birth and the other mandatory contact fields (email stays optional on staff create).
Clients index adds Missing details and name-review filters; the client page shows a non-blocking missing-details prompt.
The privacy notice names date of birth purpose and retention, and the consent policy version is 2026-11.
affected_areas: Staff Clients create, search and show
Local public login, passkeys and password reset
Privacy notice and consent policy version
version_rationale: MINOR: new identity fields and account-state behaviour for profile-only clients, without removing existing accounts or changing the display-name contract.
validation: PHPUnit ClientDetailsAndAccountStateTest plus StaffClientAccountTest, PublicAccountLifecycleTest, PublicLegalPagesTest and related suites.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for Clients and privacy.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.76.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Creating a sign-in account from a profile-only record is deferred to a later version.
Automatic matching of public register to staff-created profiles is deferred to a later version.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.75.1). Roll back the two additive migrations if the database must match that tag.
provenance: Milestone v0.76.0 Client details, date of birth and profile-only clients, Epic #864, pull request #1069.
